1: import type { Client, TextChannel, User } from 'discord.js';
2: import { getDb } from '../db/index.js';
3: import { digestLog, type ListingRow, type ServerRow } from '../db/schema.js';
4: import { DIGEST_SECTION_CAP } from '../utils/constants.js';
5: import type { DigestTrigger } from '../types/index.js';
6: import { digestLine } from '../utils/embeds.js';
7: import { prepareDigestListings, setServerWatermark } from './digest-state.js';
8: import { sendCriticalAlert } from './alerts.js';
9: import { retryWithBackoff } from '../utils/retry.js';
10: 
11: const now = () => Date.now();
12: 
13: export interface DigestResult {
14:   sent: boolean;
15:   channelOk: boolean;
16:   dmOk: boolean;
17:   listingCount: number;
18: }
19: 
20: /**
21:  * Format a digest message body from the collected listings, grouped by type.
22:  * Each section is capped and overflows are noted.
23:  */
24: export function formatDigest(listingsToShow: ListingRow[]): string {
25:   const groups = {
26:     have: listingsToShow.filter((l) => l.intent === 'have'),
27:     want: listingsToShow.filter((l) => l.intent === 'want'),
28:   };
29: 
30:   const sections: string[] = [];
31:   const pushSection = (title: string, rows: ListingRow[]): void => {
32:     if (rows.length === 0) {
33:       return;
34:     }
35:     const shown = rows.slice(0, DIGEST_SECTION_CAP);
36:     const lines = shown.map(digestLine).join('\n');
37:     const overflow =
38:       rows.length > DIGEST_SECTION_CAP ? `\n+${rows.length - DIGEST_SECTION_CAP} more` : '';
39:     sections.push(`${title} (${rows.length})\n${lines}${overflow}`);
40:   };
41: 
42:   pushSection('NEW HAVES', groups.have);
43:   pushSection('NEW WANTS', groups.want);
44: 
45:   return sections.join('\n\n');
46: }
47: 
48: /**
49:  * Run a digest for one server. Follows the watermark rules in the spec: only
50:  * listings created after `last_digest_at` are selected, delivery is by
51:  * `digest_mode`, and the watermark only advances when at least one destination
52:  * succeeds.
53:  */
54: export async function runDigest(
55:   client: Client,
56:   server: ServerRow,
57:   trigger: DigestTrigger,
58: ): Promise<DigestResult> {
59:   const collected = prepareDigestListings(server);
60: 
61:   const empty: DigestResult = { sent: false, channelOk: false, dmOk: false, listingCount: 0 };
62:   if (collected.length === 0) {
63:     return empty;
64:   }
65: 
66:   const heading = `Daily Listing Digest — ${new Date(now()).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
67:     year: 'numeric',
68:     month: 'long',
69:     day: 'numeric',
70:   })}`;
71:   const message = `${heading}\n\n${formatDigest(collected)}`;
72: 
73:   let channelOk = false;
74:   let dmOk = false;
75:   if (server.digestMode === 'channel' || server.digestMode === 'both') {
76:     channelOk = await deliverToChannel(client, server, message);
77:   }
78:   if (server.digestMode === 'dm' || server.digestMode === 'both') {
79:     dmOk = await deliverToDm(client, server, message);
80:   }
81: 
82:   if (!channelOk && !dmOk) {
83:     // No destination succeeded; record the failure and leave the watermark
84:     // unchanged so the same listings are retried next time.
85:     logDigest(server.id, trigger, collected, { channel: false, dm: false });
86:     sendCriticalAlert(`Digest delivery failed for server ${server.id}`);
87:     return { sent: false, channelOk, dmOk, listingCount: collected.length };
88:   }
89: 
90:   setServerWatermark(server.id, now());
91:   logDigest(server.id, trigger, collected, { channel: channelOk, dm: dmOk });
92:   return { sent: true, channelOk, dmOk, listingCount: collected.length };
93: }
94: 
95: async function deliverToChannel(
96:   client: Client,
97:   server: ServerRow,
98:   message: string,
99: ): Promise<boolean> {
100:   if (!server.adminChannelId) {
101:     return false;
102:   }
103:   try {
104:     const channel = (await client.channels.fetch(server.adminChannelId)) as TextChannel | null;
105:     if (!channel || !channel.isTextBased() || !channel.isSendable()) {
106:       return false;
107:     }
108:     await retryWithBackoff(() => channel.send(message), {
109:       attempts: 3,
110:       baseDelayMs: 1000,
111:       maxDelayMs: 8000,
112:     });
113:     return true;
114:   } catch {
115:     return false;
116:   }
117: }
118: 
119: async function deliverToDm(client: Client, server: ServerRow, message: string): Promise<boolean> {
120:   if (!server.digestDmUserId) {
121:     return false;
122:   }
123:   try {
124:     const user = (await client.users.fetch(server.digestDmUserId)) as User | null;
125:     if (!user) {
126:       return false;
127:     }
128:     await retryWithBackoff(() => user.send(message), {
129:       attempts: 3,
130:       baseDelayMs: 1000,
131:       maxDelayMs: 8000,
132:     });
133:     return true;
134:   } catch {
135:     return false;
136:   }
137: }
138: 
139: function logDigest(
140:   serverId: string,
141:   trigger: DigestTrigger,
142:   included: ListingRow[],
143:   results: { channel: boolean; dm: boolean },
144: ): void {
145:   const db = getDb();
146:   db.insert(digestLog)
147:     .values({
148:       serverId,
149:       sentAt: now(),
150:       trigger,
151:       listingCount: included.length,
152:       listingIdsIncluded: JSON.stringify(included.map((l) => l.id)),
153:       deliveryResults: JSON.stringify(results),
154:     })
155:     .run();
156: }

1: import { EmbedBuilder, ColorResolvable } from 'discord.js';
2: import {
3:   ACCEPTS_LABELS,
4:   CONDITION_LABELS,
5:   FINISH_LABELS,
6:   INTENT_LABELS,
7:   VARIANT_LABELS,
8: } from './constants.js';
9: import { buildManapoolUrl } from './manapool.js';
10: import { normalizeCardName } from './validation.js';
11: import type { ListingRow } from '../db/schema.js';
12: 
13: const BRAND_COLOR: ColorResolvable = 0x8f1d2c; // Liverpool red
14: 
15: /** The bot's brand color used on every embed. */
16: export function brandColor(): ColorResolvable {
17:   return BRAND_COLOR;
18: }
19: 
20: /** Format cents as a USD currency string, or an empty string when unset. */
21: export function formatPrice(priceCents: number | null | undefined): string {
22:   if (priceCents === null || priceCents === undefined) {
23:     return '';
24:   }
25:   return (priceCents / 100).toLocaleString('en-US', {
26:     style: 'currency',
27:     currency: 'USD',
28:   });
29: }
30: 
31: /** Build an embed title line: `{Intent} · {Accepts} — {Card Name} (SET)`. */
32: export function formatListingTitle(listing: {
33:   intent: string;
34:   accepts: string;
35:   cardName: string;
36:   cardSet?: string | null;
37: }): string {
38:   const intent = INTENT_LABELS[listing.intent as keyof typeof INTENT_LABELS] ?? listing.intent;
39:   const accepts = ACCEPTS_LABELS[listing.accepts as keyof typeof ACCEPTS_LABELS] ?? listing.accepts;
40:   const set = listing.cardSet ? ` (${listing.cardSet})` : '';
41:   return `${intent} · ${accepts} — ${listing.cardName}${set}`;
42: }
43: 
44: /** Resolve the Manapool link for a listing, falling back to a locally-built URL. */
45: function listingManapoolUrl(listing: ListingRow): string | null {
46:   return (
47:     listing.manapoolUrl ??
48:     buildManapoolUrl({
49:       cardName: listing.cardName,
50:       cardSet: listing.cardSet,
51:       collectorNumber: listing.collectorNumber,
52:     })
53:   );
54: }
55: 
56: /**
57:  * Build the full embed for a single listing (used by `/have`, `/want`, and
58:  * their batch/edit success replies). `showUser` adds a "Posted by" line,
59:  * used where the poster isn't otherwise implied by context.
60:  */
61: export function listingEmbed(
62:   listing: ListingRow,
63:   options: { showUser?: boolean } = {},
64: ): EmbedBuilder {
65:   const embed = new EmbedBuilder()
66:     .setColor(BRAND_COLOR)
67:     .setTitle(formatListingTitle(listing))
68:     .setFooter({ text: `Listing #${listing.id}` })
69:     .setTimestamp(new Date(listing.createdAt));
70: 
71:   const manapoolUrl = listingManapoolUrl(listing);
72:   if (manapoolUrl) {
73:     embed.setURL(manapoolUrl);
74:   }
75: 
76:   const fields: Array<{ name: string; value: string; inline: boolean }> = [];
77:   if (listing.condition) {
78:     const label =
79:       CONDITION_LABELS[listing.condition as keyof typeof CONDITION_LABELS] ?? listing.condition;
80:     fields.push({ name: 'Condition', value: label, inline: true });
81:   }
82:   if (listing.priceCents !== null && listing.priceCents !== undefined) {
83:     fields.push({ name: 'Price', value: formatPrice(listing.priceCents), inline: true });
84:   }
85:   fields.push({ name: 'Quantity', value: String(listing.quantity), inline: true });
86:   if (listing.finish) {
87:     const label = FINISH_LABELS[listing.finish as keyof typeof FINISH_LABELS] ?? listing.finish;
88:     fields.push({ name: 'Finish', value: label, inline: true });
89:   }
90:   if (listing.variant) {
91:     const label = VARIANT_LABELS[listing.variant as keyof typeof VARIANT_LABELS] ?? listing.variant;
92:     fields.push({ name: 'Variant', value: label, inline: true });
93:   }
94:   if (listing.collectorNumber) {
95:     fields.push({ name: 'Collector #', value: listing.collectorNumber, inline: true });
96:   }
97:   if (listing.notes) {
98:     fields.push({ name: 'Notes', value: listing.notes, inline: false });
99:   }
100:   if (fields.length > 0) {
101:     embed.addFields(fields);
102:   }
103: 
104:   if (options.showUser && listing.username) {
105:     embed.setDescription(`Posted by <@${listing.userId}> (${listing.username})`);
106:   }
107:   if (listing.cardImageUrl) {
108:     embed.setThumbnail(listing.cardImageUrl);
109:   }
110:   return embed;
111: }
112: 
113: /** Build a compact single-line description used inside digests. */
114: export function digestLine(listing: ListingRow): string {
115:   const set = listing.cardSet ? ` (${listing.cardSet})` : '';
116:   const condition = listing.condition
117:     ? ` — ${CONDITION_LABELS[listing.condition as keyof typeof CONDITION_LABELS] ?? listing.condition}`
118:     : '';
119:   const price =
120:     listing.priceCents !== null && listing.priceCents !== undefined
121:       ? ` — ${formatPrice(listing.priceCents)}`
122:       : '';
123:   const manapoolUrl = listingManapoolUrl(listing);
124:   const link = manapoolUrl ? ` — [View on Manapool](${manapoolUrl})` : '';
125:   return `- ${listing.cardName}${set}${condition}${price} — @${listing.username}${link}`;
126: }
127: 
128: /**
129:  * Build the card-cache key from a card name plus its printing details.
130:  * `services/card-cache.ts`'s `buildCacheKey` is a thin wrapper around this.
131:  */
132: export function cardKey(
133:   cardName: string,
134:   cardSet?: string | null,
135:   finish?: string | null,
136:   variant?: string | null,
137:   collectorNumber?: string | null,
138: ): string {
139:   const base = normalizeCardName(cardName);
140:   const parts = [base];
141:   if (cardSet) parts.push(cardSet.toUpperCase());
142:   if (collectorNumber) parts.push(`CN${collectorNumber.toUpperCase()}`);
143:   if (finish) parts.push(finish);
144:   if (variant) parts.push(variant);
145:   return parts.join('::');
146: }
